columns_and_units.note: TLC-style names, payment=1, USD, miles, minute duration and ratio target recovered; fixture column mapping is synthetic.

card_target.note: Card sample includes zero tips; baseline main sample uses positive tips. Demo supports both explicitly.

time_resolution.note: Naive New York times; ambiguous/nonexistent times quarantined. No historical timezone guarantee.

economic_filters.note: Positive finite fare, distance and duration; nonnegative finite tips; no default upper caps. Historical caps documented separately.

identity_and_duplicates.note: File bytes plus original record ordinal identify rows; identical content retained and grouped.

zone_join.note: Unique-key left joins with explicit match flags.

weather_join.note: Synthetic station mapping and 60-minute tolerance; nearest descriptive observation, earlier tie.

split_and_sampling.note: SHA256 grouping/ranking, seed 42, 70/15/15 bucket boundaries; not historical DuckDB hash reproduction. Caps apply per split and tip stratum.

learning_boundary.note: Training-only category fitting recovered; the preparation demo adds no learned transformations.
